ambiguities: PH4 does not expressly say whether a syntactically stated full-case containment becomes invalid for PH4 when Covered validity fails solely because a material Rust authority premise is unchecked; that case also independently fits G11. The P18/P19 and P22/P23 dependency chains support treating H's affirmative whole-domain claims as PH4, but the overlap boundary is not explicit.

H's phrase 'on that same domain' in the behavioral verdict unambiguously imports the audit domain but is grammatically ambiguous about importing the preceding soundness bullet's BUILD-MAP-POLICY qualification.
